criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Seeking
categories.definition: Requests for general information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and statistics.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries about travel restrictions, safety, and guidelines related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Health and Safety Precautions
categories.definition: Questions regarding measures to protect oneself and others from COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment and Cures
categories.definition: Requests for information about treatments, cures, and medical advice related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Myth Busting
categories.definition: Inquiries or statements regarding myths and misinformation about COVID-19.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: Requests for information on how to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Questions about symptoms of COVID-19 and how to determine if one is infected.

categories.name: Animal Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries about the impact of COVID-19 on animals and potential transmission from animals to humans.

categories.name: Cleaning and Disinfection
categories.definition: Questions about how to properly clean and disinfect surfaces to prevent the spread of COVID-19.

categories.name: Updates and News
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news, updates, and press releases regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Community Impact
categories.definition: Inquiries about the effects of COVID-19 on local communities and populations.

categories.name: Public Health Guidelines
categories.definition: Requests for information on public health guidelines and recommendations during the pandemic.
